preconditions.description: The number of levels n must be between 1 and 7000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 7000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= l <= r <= cnt[t] and 1 <= x <= 10**6 for operation in operations if operation[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For each type 1 operation, the level t, positions l and r, and value x must be within valid bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= v <= cnt[t] for operation in operations if operation[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For each type 2 operation, the level t and position v must be within valid bounds.

postconditions.description: The output for the given example input must match the specified output.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The results of type 2 operations must be integers.
The number of results must match the number of type 2 operations.
